{{quote|They're readable. Not masterpiece but written with feeling.|Item description}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' item is part of the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is obtainable through the [[Donkey|donkey's]] questline. It can be crafted infinitely before being given to the donkey in the quest line, but provides no other value and cannot be destroyed.


'''When used keeper says:''' 

"Dishonest people shouldn't be rich. And honest people are allowed to be rich. And dishonest." 

"Those who have plenty are not wealthy. It's those who give that are truly wealthy. Those who give a lot!" 

"There're few people who can tolerate wealth. Other people's wealth, that is."
